name: Dell Latitude 7220EX
statusNote: No longer sold, and its IECEx certificate was cancelled in 2023. Dell has no Ex successor.
summary: The Dell Latitude 7220EX is the hazardous-area version of a Dell rugged 11.6-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 Pro. It has been discontinued.

otherSchemes: ATEX and IECEx Zone 2 and Zone 22 (Dell marketing)

atex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic IIIB T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx CANCELLED 2023-06-22. Certificate note: cancellation does not affect equipment released before that date. ATEX status not found.

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic IIIB T130°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: Class I Division 2 expected on the base model (Dell blog Dec 2019, via research); not verified

safety.conditions: The equipment does not meet the dielectric strength requirement and must not be connected to or disconnected from external devices or interfaces in explosive atmospheres. All external interfaces closed in operation; I/O accessories not allowed. Use only the listed Dell 45 W, 65 W or 90 W power adapters. The integrated Li-ion battery pack must not be replaced or adjusted by users. Repair only by Dell.
safety.peripherals: All external interfaces must remain closed and no I/O accessories may be connected in the explosive atmosphere.

os.name: Windows
os.edition: Windows 10 Pro as shipped; Windows 11 Pro 64-bit also supported by Dell
os.upgradeLimit: Dell validates Windows 11 up to 25H2; no last supported version stated. Core i5-8365U is an 8th-generation Core i5, on Microsoft's Windows 11 supported list
os.updates: Windows 11: supported while kept on a current version (Microsoft Modern Lifecycle)

specs.chip: Intel Core i5-8365U vPro (8th gen, 4 cores, 1.6 GHz base, up to 4.1 GHz)
specs.ruggedness: MIL-STD-810G and MIL-STD-810H tested (Dell); drop height not stated in the guide

capabilities.label: Windows desktop software
capabilities.value: Built in (Windows 10 Pro, x86; out of support)

strengths: Certified for ambient temperatures up to +60 °C
limitations: No longer in the maker's current range
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
